title: AI doesn't need more speed. It needs a standard.
lede: Raw AI generates from scratch every time. Fonderie gives it a shared, audited vocabulary — so it composes, not hallucinates.

features.title: Standard modules
features.text: Auth, billing, permissions, workspaces — each a typed, tested primitive. Not a template; a building block.

features.title: AI-readable skills
features.text: Skill files in your repo spell out how the modules wire together. No prompt engineering. No drift between sessions.

features.title: Reviewable output
features.text: Composition resolves to plain TypeScript in your repo — diffable, testable, auditable line by line.

codeFooter: Every module exposes the same contract, so composition is a lookup — not a guess.
